subject: Launch briefing: marketplace visibility playbook & SLA ask
messages:
From: John Dobson <john.dobson@acme-inc.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing: hero claim evidence + trial hook

Lauren —

Thanks for the quick walkthrough earlier. Procurement at Acme is moving fast and they want two things cleared before they sign: (1) concrete proofpoints for the hero claim about ‘40% inference cost reduction’ and (2) whether we can map a PrivateOffer SKU for a 30-day trial tied to their account (they need trial entitlement on AWS side). They asked we send a short bundle of evidence and a clear list of procurement-facing copy snippets they can include in their internal purchase request.

Would you and the marketplace team be able to share the evidence pack and confirm PrivateOffer SKU flow? Also, is there an SLA uplift option (latency SLO) we can call out on the listing to reassure platform teams?

I attached the draft internal request they will submit (see attached).

—John
Senior Product Manager, Acme

Attachments: Acme_Internal_Request.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: John Dobson <john.dobson@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: hero claim evidence + trial hook

John —

Great, thanks for the clear ask and the file. We're on it. Quick plan:
- Kimberly will assemble a compact evidence bundle (benchmarks, runbook, and data retention notes) you can attach to the purchase request.
- Aditya will confirm PrivateOffer SKU naming and the entitlement mechanics for a 30-day trial (we've done similar flows before, but will validate the exact steps for AWS billing).
- I'll pull together a short procurement-friendly copy snippet (2–3 lines) that states the SLA & region parity and includes a link to the evidence bundle.

Two quick clarifications that will speed things up:
1) Do you need the cost-reduction proofpoint to be broken down by model/instance class (e.g., LLM-1 on p4d vs. q8 on a100)?
2) Who is the technical approver on your side if we need a quick call with platform engineering?

Looping in Kimberly and Aditya for ETA.

Thanks —
Lauren
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Hero_Claims_v3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: hero claim evidence + trial hook

Team —

As discussed, I put together a compact evidence pack and a short copy sheet for procurement. Highlights included in the ZIP:
- single-page benchmark summary (40% avg cost-per-token reduction vs baseline LLM-1 on p4d under our batching + KV cache config)
- methodology notes (sequence lengths, batching assumptions, quantization details)
- sample telemetry screenshots (latency percentiles, cost per 1k tokens)
- a short legal-friendly footnote for the listing about the benchmark (what ‘typical workloads’ means)

On PrivateOffer SKU: Aditya confirmed we can reserve a trial SKU and attach an entitlement that expires after 30 days. The steps we will follow:
1) Create PrivateOffer SKU in AWS Seller Console with reserved trial quota
2) Provide Acme with a redemption ARN and entitlement mapping
3) Validate entitlement in a short smoke test with Acme's technical approver

SLA uplift: we don't typically publish latency SLAs on the public listing. We can offer a private SLA addendum for the PrivateOffer and include an enterprise-facing blurb on the listing pointing to contact@redwood.com for SLA discussions. Suggested copy: "Enterprise SLA options available for dedicated and PrivateOffer customers; contact sales for latency commitments and on-prem deployment options."

Irene — can you quick-verify the legal-friendly footnote language in the attached PDF?

Attachments: Marketplace_Evidence_Pack.zip, Redwood_Seller_Sku_Playbook.docx
From: John Dobson <john.dobson@acme-inc.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: hero claim evidence + trial hook

Kimberly / Lauren —

This is great, thanks. The breakdown by instance class would be useful for our infra team but not required for procurement — the single-page summary will do. Our technical approver is Priya Shah (priya.shah@acme-inc.com); she can join a 20–30 minute smoke test next week.

We also want the procurement copy snippet you suggested so we can paste it into our internal purchase justification. If you can add the SKU redemption steps in the PDF (one-liner instructions) that will be perfect.

I've cc'd AWS Marketplace ops to track the PrivateOffer SKU creation and any seller-console follow-ups.

Next steps per our side: Priya will be the contact for the smoke test; I'll confirm a time early next week.

Cheers —
John

Referenced attachments: Marketplace_Evidence_Pack.zip
